$comment: THE COURSE MANIFEST — the one place that says what content exists.
Nothing in src/ names a course, a unit or a graph file. src/content/index.js
reads this file, resolves the graphs beside it, loads the generator packs the
units name, and hands the engine a graph. Adding Algebra II, Geometry or
Trigonometry is: write a graph, write a pack, add a block here.
See content/COURSES.md for the full walk-through.
courses[].id        stable id; used in the save and in ?course=
courses[].titleKey  i18n key for the course name (src/i18n)
courses[].frameworks which standards frameworks its nodes cite
units[].id          stable id; used in ?unit= and names the graph file
units[].graph       path, relative to content/, of the unit's graph
units[].pack        generator pack module id, or null for the core bank
units[].requires    unit ids whose nodes this unit's prereqs may point at
default names the unit a player gets when nothing asks for anything else.
It must never change without a migration: it is the shipped experience.
